verdict.rationale: Penpot ships and documents a first-party MCP server for design-to-code workflows, explicitly stating AI agents can read/interact with design files (frames, components, code-based structure) and that design tokens/variables are supported; a runtime probe confirms the official self-hosted MCP service completes a real JSON-RPC handshake with a tools capability and 'high_level_overview' tool, corroborating the vendor claims beyond marketing copy. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of specific MCP tool calls for screenshots/variable extraction and third-party confirmation of component-mapping fidelity in practice.
